# Random_Parameter_Substitution

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The practice of replacing computationally derived metrics with randomly generated values in simulation experiments, often to bypass complex calculations. Identifies a critical failure mode that invalidates all downstream analyses and undermines the integrity of neuromorphic simulation research.
